text:
maria: Heads-up — PR #4321 CI smoke is red on gpu-smoke-hetero. A subset of tests hit OOMKilled inside the container and a short CUDA error appears right before the OOM. Anyone seen this pattern?

simon: link to the job?

maria: https://ci.internal/redwood/4321/console — last 40 lines pasted below.

maria: ```
[  123.456] container: running test compile_and_run_gpu
E CudaRuntime: cudaErrorIllegalAddress: an illegal memory access was encountered
E Runtime: kernel: GPU page fault at 0x7fcae0000000, not-present
[  123.459] container: process killed: OOMKilled
--- end of log ---
```

priya: is this reproducible locally or only on the hetero CI nodes? which image + host driver?

maria: Image: redwood/gpu-ci:cuda12.2-driver535-202603, host driver on the failing node is 535.54, node labels: gpu-type=hetero,a100+l40. Repro locally on an a100 VM gives a different error (launch timeout).

esteban: that combo smells like a user/container runtime ABI mismatch. If the container libcuda doesn't match host driver we can get illegal-addresss/pagefaults + OOM as allocs fail. We've seen similar when host driver > container libs. Can we rerun on a homogeneous a100 node and collect dmesg?

maria: good call. @infra-bot can you queue a rerun pinned to node label `gpu=homogeneous-a100` and attach `--collect-dmesg`?

infra-bot: Rerun queued: job 4321.rerun.1 -> scheduled on ci-a100-12. Gathering logs and dmesg.

infra-bot: Rerun started on ci-a100-12 (driver 535.54).

infra-bot: Rerun finished — job 4321.rerun.1 failed with same OOMKilled. dmesg excerpt: "NVRM: Xid (63) -- GPU page fault (reason 31) at GPC 2".

priya: can you paste `nvidia-smi -q` and `ldd /usr/local/cuda/lib64/libcuda.so` from the node?

maria: ```
# nvidia-smi -q | head -n20
Product Name                    : NVIDIA A100
Driver Version                  : 535.54
CUDA Version                    : 12.2

# ldd /usr/local/cuda/lib64/libcuda.so
	linux-vdso.so.1 =>  (0x00007ffd...)
	libnvidia-ml.so.1 => /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libnvidia-ml.so.1 (0x00007f...)
	...
```

esteban: looks like the host driver and libnvidia are consistent, but the container's CUDA runtime could still be from a different ABI. Try forcing the `nvidia` runtime instead of the default runc wrapper and mount host `/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu` into the container for libs. Also collect `modinfo nvidia` and `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version` on the host.

priya: I'm going to run a quick canary: start a container with `--gpus=all --runtime=nvidia` on ci-a100-12 and run the failing smoke test with `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` to get better backtraces. Command: 
```
docker run --rm --gpus=all --runtime=nvidia -e CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 -v /var/log/dmesg:/host-dmesg redwood/gpu-ci:cuda12.2-driver535-202603 bash -c "pytest tests/smoke_gpu.py::test_compile_and_run -q"
```

simon: also try swapping to image built with system-driver bind-mount: `-v /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:ro` — avoids mismatched libcuda in the image.

infra-bot: Canary run started (canary-4321-1) on ci-a100-12.

infra-bot: Canary run completed: test failed reproducibly. Collected backtrace attached. dmesg shows repeated page faults before the final OOM.

maria: thanks. I'm opening infra ticket infra-527 to coordinate a driver matrix canary across 530/535/540 and also to test the bind-mount approach. tagging @infra.

esteban: good. I'll schedule the matrix and loop in infra ops to repro on baremetal (no sandbox caps). If it reproduces only inside the sandbox we can narrow to container runtime.

priya: short-term mitigation: add an automatic retry on OOMKilled for these smoke tests (1 retry) and a flaky mark so PRs aren't blocked while infra bisects. Will open a small PR for that.

maria: SGTM. For now I've dropped a note on the PR and updated the CI checklist. Thanks all — will post findings in infra-527 once we have matrix results. :handshake:

esteban: ping me if you want me to run a bisect across kernel versions too. I'll start with driver matrix and then kernel if needed. :thumbsup:
